Git Change Proposals
|-- [M] Push intake: PushIntegrationService -> PushSource + PushWorkflow + store
|   |-- Public boundary: connect, receive, get, generations

|   |   |   `-- Same ID + different event -> PUSH_EVENT_ID_CONFLICT
|   |   `-- Create generation once -> classify push
|   |       |-- Non-branch ref, deletion, or unchanged endpoint -> skipped
|   |       `-- GitPushSource.resolve -> no net tree change: skipped
|   |           `-- Net change -> workflow.start(pinned context, requestId = generation ID)
|   |               `-- Store run/proposal IDs; get refreshes a running generation from its run
|   `-- [M] GitPushSource exposes validateConnection + resolve; Git execution stays internal
|       |-- Find registered checkout whose repository identity matches
|       |-- Ensure before/after commits exist; fetch missing endpoints by SHA

|           |-- commits = after's reachable graph excluding before's reachable graph
|           |-- kind = new branch, update, or force push according to ancestry
|           `-- hasChanges = before tree differs from after tree
|               `-- New branch compares against empty tree; moving branch HEAD is not an input
|-- [M] Agent orchestration: DiffSessionWorkflowService
|   |-- Public boundary: start, get, cancel, dispose
|   |   |-- Request selects a baseline session OR repository/commit context
|   |   `-- Request ID identifies run; mismatched replay conflicts; concurrent starts share work
|   |-- [C] start -> begin -> background execute
|   |   |-- ChangeSessionService.capture -> frozen capture [A]
|   |   |   `-- Require pinned context and nonempty hunks; persist context + prompts as artifacts
|   |   |-- Open runtime session with DiffSessionTools
|   |   |   `-- Dependencies: captured source reader, proposal service, agent canvas service
|   |   |-- runAgentWorkflow: analyze -> materialize -> validate
|   |   |   |-- Persist each step's request/response, conversation, and performance metrics
|   |   |   `-- Returned proposal must belong to these tools and have status ready
|   |   `-- Success -> completed, ready for review; acceptance is a separate operation
|   `-- [O] Workflow service owns active abort controllers and live run state
|       |-- cancel -> abort signal; shutdown -> abort active runs + dispose runtime
|       |-- Failure -> failed; aborted execution -> cancelled
|       |-- Finally -> save artifacts, dispose agent session, save run; remove live/active entries
|       `-- Stored running run without local active/start state -> reported interrupted
|-- [M] Proposal workspace: ChangeSessionService
|   |-- Public boundary: capture/create, snapshot/descriptor, apply/createDocument, update

|   |   `-- Internal machinery: serialization, history/controller reconstruction, change derivation

|   |   |-- Selected live workspace snapshots -> replace matching saved baselines
|   |   |   `-- Multiple live workspaces require canvasId; repository mismatch rejects capture
|   |   `-- Alternative: baselineChangeSessionId -> reuse original baselines + pinned hunks
|   |       `-- Reset proposed copies/history; do not inherit the older proposal's edits
|   |-- [O] create clones [A] into an isolated draft, version 0
|   |   |-- Session ID derives from projectId + requestId; stored signature guards replay
|   |   |-- Each existing document retains baseline, saved revision ID, and proposed copy
|   |   |-- New document has baseline = null

|   |-- [C] apply -> MappingDocumentController.applyUpdate -> record -> refreshChanges
